hooks.command: f=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$f" ] && [ -n "$root" ] && [[ "$f" == "$root"/my-app/docs/* ]]; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Docs must live under <repo-root>/docs/, never my-app/docs/. Write under docs/ instead (e.g. docs/superpowers/plans/, docs/superpowers/specs/)."}}'; fi
